title: React InstantSearch + Expo SDK 54 — TypeError: constructor is not callable
explanation: This GitHub issue describes a runtime error encountered when upgrading to Expo SDK 54 while using React InstantSearch. The user is experiencing a 'TypeError: constructor is not callable' error, which suggests a compatibility issue between the libraries and the new Expo version. The user expresses frustration and confusion around the problem and is seeking guidance on recommended configurations and potential workarounds.
